order: Two repeats per lane; second reverses corpus order. Mapping lane completes before allocation lane.
claims: Unchanged source; no optimization candidate or acceptance rerun.
Mapping stacks identify attributed syscall requests, not physical pages or minor-fault causation.
DHAT records allocation requests under its replacement allocator; it does not preserve native allocator mappings, page faults, timing or RSS.
Attribute only stacks containing both write_plain and ordinary_save::run_case; retain and report all other contexts separately.
No native latency claim; all traced/profiled elapsed and procfs values are diagnostic only.
Fixed repetitions, no discarded results or replacement child.
An unresolved/truncated stack cannot establish owner absence; fail closed on insufficient owner evidence.
Mapping traces include100warmups and200measuredphaseinvocations; conservative markerwindows retaincontrol/warmup/measured separation and acquisition-order faultbuckets.

marker_protocol.window: after before-snapshot status-open event and before after-snapshot io-open event
marker_protocol.scope: Conservative operation bracket includes before-probe tail; owner-stack attribution excludes probe calls. This is not the exact clock interval.
marker_protocol.mapping_alignment: Skip32controlpairs and100warmup iterationpairs; align200remainingwindows with acquisition-order process_probe.sample_deltas.

stop_rule: Retain all8fixedchildren. Missing/unresolved marker or owner stacks mean phase attribution unavailable, not zero events. No replacement child; no extra profiling lane to hunt for a desired regime.
